title: Recording: Time To Hide by Wings | 1976
content:
Studio Two, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Peter Henderson

Wings re-recorded the Wings At The Speed Of Sound song ‘Time To Hide’ on 27 January 1976.

They had begun work on the song on 15 January. During this session they started afresh, but despite working on it for 10 hours, a master take proved elusive. Wings returned to ‘Time To Hide’ on 30 January.
